youtube_description:
Subscribe:  https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC51g2r_bWOQq-7Y-VwU9sYA?sub_confirmation=1

Link to Tome:  https://beta.tome.app/

In this video, the presenter talks about how to get 100 free credits for using Dall-E, an AI tool that generates images from text prompts. The presenter shows that he is logged into Dall-E and has 49 credits. He then introduces the viewers to the AI app Tome, a presentation software that integrates with Dall-E and provides free access to the AI tool.

 The presenter explains that Tome is currently in beta and free to use. He shows that he has 435 credits in Tome and demonstrates how to use Dall-E within Tome to generate free images.
